description: The bar chart illustrates the bias percentage in responses generated by language models before and after instruction tuning across three categories: Support of Authorities, Extended Contact, and Virtual Contact. The vertical axis represents the bias percentage, ranging from 0 to 70, while the horizontal axis lists the three categories. Each category has three bars representing the bias percentage before instruction tuning (lighter shaded bars) and after instruction tuning (darker shaded bars). For Support of Authorities, the bias percentage decreases from 39.50% before tuning to 0.04% after tuning. In the Extended Contact category, the bias percentage drops from 40.61% before tuning to 0.00% after tuning. Lastly, for Virtual Contact, the bias percentage is reduced from 39.74% before tuning to 0.11% after tuning. The chart shows that instruction-tuning on certain key principles can eliminate bias to nearly zero across prompts specific to Support of Authorities and Extended Contact, and considerably reduce bias across Virtual Contact prompts.
